findings_qualitative.value: Nuclei with 11.3 micron PAH detection have higher gas mass and column density; AGN luminosity and r_AGN differ little

evidence.quote: There is little dependence of the detection of nuclear $11.3\,\mu$m PAH emission on either AGN luminosity or distance from the AGN.

findings_qualitative.value: IRS PAH ratios do not trend with nuclear N(H2) because CO is mostly not centrally peaked

evidence.quote: There is no clear dependence of the *Spitzer*/IRS PAH ratios on the nuclear column density

claims.hypothesis: Molecular gas shields PAHs in Seyfert nuclei
claims.experiment: Compare CO(2-1) gas mass and N(H2) in slit regions between PAH-detected and non-detected nuclei
claims.result: Medians 1.6e7 vs 2e6 Msun; N(H2) 2e23 vs 4e22 cm-2; K-S 2% and 0.8%
claims.finding: High N(H2) plays a role in protecting PAHs

evidence.quote: This suggests that molecular gas plays a role in shielding the PAH molecules in the harsh environments of Seyfert nuclei.

claims.hypothesis: X-ray dissociation half-life differs with PAH detection
claims.experiment: Naphthalene half-life at 2.5 keV from N(H2), L_X, r_AGN
claims.result: Shorter half-lives in nuclei without detection
claims.finding: Half-lives are shorter in non-detections, but mostly shorter than injection timescales

evidence.quote: We estimate shorter half-lives for naphthalene in nuclei without a $11.3\,\mu$m PAH detection than in those with a detection.

claims.hypothesis: High nuclear N(H2) implies more neutral PAHs on circumnuclear scales
claims.experiment: Compare IRS PAH ratios with nuclear N(H2)
claims.finding: Not generally closer to neutral tracks, as CO is not centrally peaked

evidence.quote: However, Seyfert galaxies in our sample with the highest nuclear H$_2$ column densities are not generally closer to the neutral PAH tracks.

limitations_admitted.value: Half-lives are indicative only; uncertain H2 masses, averaged N(H2), only naphthalene, dehydrogenation ignored

evidence.quote: We remark that these half-lives are only indicative of the general behavior.

referee_caveats_inferred: Small sample (22) with heterogeneous ALMA/NOEMA beams and mid-IR slits
Detection of PAH depends on sensitivity and continuum of each mid-IR spectrum
Constant r21=1 and Galactic X_CO may bias masses
Naphthalene is a poor proxy for the large PAHs dominating emission
